title: My Thrill Club Alternatives: 6 Thriller Book Boxes - Cratejoy
summary: Compare six thriller, mystery, and horror book boxes like My Thrill Club, from one-book clubs under $20 to a four-book box shipped from the UK.
body_markdown:
A themed horror package


### Night Worms vs My Thrill Club


**Best for:** Horror fans who want a themed monthly package and don’t mind preordering.


[Night Worms](https://nightworms.com/) is a monthly horror package picked by two horror fans, built around a theme. November 2026’s theme is Creatures in the Dark, with two books, one hardcover and one paperback, plus a goodie bag that usually holds a bookmark, a sticker, and a drink.


#### What feels familiar


Horror is all it does, and November’s two books match My Thrill Club’s count.


#### What changes


It costs more than the one-book clubs here, and shipping is extra. Packages sell as preorders weeks before they ship, and each month’s books are announced with its theme. Subscribers are charged on the 7th, so cancel before then to stop the next package.
